2. Cougar-Egy E1900 Vertical Rechargeable Mouse Specifications

Technical Specifications

  • Model Name: E1900

  • Type: Vertical Ergonomic Mouse

  • Connectivity: Dual Mode (Bluetooth + 2.4GHz Wireless)

  • Sensor Type: Optical (Photoelectric)

  • DPI Resolution: Adjustable (1000 / 1200 / 1600 DPI)

  • Operating Range: Up to 10 Meters

Design & Build

  • Ergonomics: 57° vertical angle design to reduce wrist strain and muscle fatigue

  • Buttons: 4 Buttons (Some variants may list 6 including side buttons)
